paragraphs.en: I can already see that you don't like it. Look, I would just start over. How about that? Okay.
paragraphs.zh: 我已经知道你不喜欢了。我会重新开始的。怎么样？可以。

paragraphs.en: Hi, my name is Taylor as you know, and this is the tear drop from the orange sky. No momma, it isn't like that at all.
paragraphs.zh: 嗨，我叫泰勒，这是橙色天空之泪。不，妈妈 ，根本不是那样的。

paragraphs.en: Dude, I've got to tell you what happened at old man Fletcher's class the other day. I mean this, this is insane.
paragraphs.zh: 伙计，我得跟你说前几天在弗莱彻老头课上发生的事儿。这简直太疯狂了。

paragraphs.en: So Drive Thru Drama, it's kind of like a Disney ride without the scary animatronics. It's driving and stopping at each actor. It's a live actor.
paragraphs.zh: 得来速戏剧秀有点像没有吓人电子动画的迪士尼游乐项目。你只需要开车在每个演员面前停下，都是现场表演的演员。

paragraphs.en: They perform a monologue where there are 10 stations and it all comes together to make one story.
paragraphs.zh: 他们表演一段独白，一共有十站，连起来是一个完整的故事。

paragraphs.en: I came across something I had learned about in theater history called medieval pageant wagons which was common at the time where actors would be on a wagon and they would do their scene and then it would move to the next town or to the next group of audience members.
paragraphs.zh: 我偶然在戏剧史中发现了中世纪巡游彩车，这在当时很常见，演员们会站在彩车上表演剧目，然后彩车会移动到下一个城镇或下一批观众面前。

paragraphs.en: So, I sort of took that idea and flipped it, where the actor stays in one place and then the audience drives around and hears the rest of the story.
paragraphs.zh: 我就借鉴了这个想法并把它反过来，让演员待在一个地方，然后观众开车四处转，听故事的其余部分。

paragraphs.en: I was a banker. I've never done anything like this. I don't know that there's ever been anything like this to do before.
paragraphs.zh: 我曾是一名银行家。我从未做过这样的事，也不知道还有这样的形式。

paragraphs.en: So, it's kind of like some of the things but still it's not. It's entirely different.
paragraphs.zh: 可能曾经听说过类似的东西，但又完全不同。

paragraphs.en: Part of my job was I would sort through the money and decide if money couldn't be used anymore.
paragraphs.zh: 我的部分工作是清点这些钱，并决定哪些钱不能再使用了。

paragraphs.en: It's in the game. Okay? All Right. You know, I have a help cushion but it's not enough.
paragraphs.zh: 我正在游戏中。我有一个缓冲的时间，但根本就不够。

paragraphs.en: Okay, listen. I think we ought to cut our losses, like try to outlast until maybe second place and then…..
paragraphs.zh: 我认为我们应该及时止损，比如试着坚持到也许第二名...

paragraphs.en: We've never done anything like this before but I'm really looking forward to it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以前完全没有看过这种表演，但我真的很期待。

paragraphs.en: We both love theater and any chance to go and see live theater, I was excited about because there hasn't been much this year.
paragraphs.zh: 我们俩都热爱戏剧，只要有机会去看现场戏剧演出，我都会很兴奋，因为今年这样的机会并不多。

paragraphs.en: Well, I thought when Danielle came to me and said, "I want to do a show," my mind went to monologues.
paragraphs.zh: 当丹妮尔来找我说“我想搞一个演出”的时候，我的脑海里浮现的是独白。

paragraphs.en: My mind went to plays that are traditionally told by one person at a time, a one-person show but spread out over 10 people.
paragraphs.zh: 我想起来以前那种一个人讲一个部分的表演，这依然是独角戏，但把整个故事分配给了10个人。

paragraphs.en: And I thought I guess that's possible to do 10 disparate stories that are all linked around one thing, which in this case is a dollar bill with some writing on it.
paragraphs.zh: 我觉得我们可以讲10个不同的故事，但是这些故事都围绕的是一个主线，在这个例子中就是一张写有字的美元钞票。

paragraphs.en: Make a small change and those sound like pretty big changes to me, pal.
paragraphs.zh: 做个小小的改变，对我来说就是很大的改变，伙计。

paragraphs.en: Yes, I am going to cue you. So, this car needs to get over to the second actor. They'll be there for just a few moments.
paragraphs.zh: 我要告诉你们怎么走了。 现在你们的车要开去第二个演员那里。他们只会在那里停留片刻。

paragraphs.en: I'm trying to pace it so there's no accordion happening on the back side. I'll let you wait it from there.
paragraphs.zh: 我正试着控制节奏，这样后面就不会出现起伏不平的情况了。我会让你从那里等着看后续。

paragraphs.en: This is, I don't know, it looks really fun. You know, and we do like to go to things like this.
paragraphs.zh: 我不知道，这看起来真的很有趣。我们确实喜欢参加这样的活动。

paragraphs.en: She had a, battery is dead in her car. I ran the air conditioning during the last half hour without the car on.
paragraphs.zh: 她车里的电池没电了。我在没有启动汽车的情况下开了半小时空调。

paragraphs.en: When they're done, they're going to give you a little bit of a bow.
paragraphs.zh: 他们表演完之后会微微鞠躬。

paragraphs.en: There's a chance for you to give a little clap and you may move on from there to the next.
paragraphs.zh: 这个时候你可以鼓掌，然后开到下一个演员那里。
